description: Source code implementing the finite state machine (FSM) for PPP protocol handling in Zephyr OS, including state transitions, packet processing, and protocol-specific logic.

methods.name: ppp_fsm_ctx
methods.description: Returns the context associated with a given FSM based on its protocol.

methods.name: ppp_fsm_iface
methods.description: Retrieves the network interface associated with the FSM.

methods.name: fsm_send_configure_req
methods.description: Sends a configuration request packet for the FSM, handling retransmission logic.

methods.name: ppp_fsm_timeout
methods.description: Handles timeout events for the FSM, managing retransmissions and state transitions.

methods.name: ppp_fsm_init
methods.description: Initializes the FSM with a specified protocol.

methods.name: fsm_down
methods.description: Transitions the FSM to a down state, resetting options and invoking callback.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates the FSM connection, sending terminate packets and transitioning states.

methods.name: ppp_fsm_close
methods.description: Closes the FSM, optionally with a reason, and transitions to appropriate states.

methods.name: ppp_fsm_lower_down
methods.description: Handles lower layer down event, adjusting FSM state accordingly.

methods.name: ppp_fsm_lower_up
methods.description: Handles lower layer up event, initiating configuration if needed.

methods.name: ppp_fsm_open
methods.description: Opens the FSM, starting negotiation or re-negotiation based on current state.

methods.name: ppp_send_pkt
methods.description: Constructs and sends a PPP packet of specified type and data.

methods.name: fsm_recv_configure_req
methods.description: Processes received configuration request packets, responding with ACK, NACK, or REJ.

methods.name: fsm_recv_configure_ack
methods.description: Processes received configuration acknowledgment packets, advancing FSM state.

methods.name: fsm_recv_configure_nack_rej
methods.description: Handles received NACK or REJ packets, updating FSM and possibly rejecting options.

methods.name: fsm_recv_terminate_req
methods.description: Processes received terminate request packets, transitioning FSM to stopping.

methods.name: fsm_recv_terminate_ack
methods.description: Processes received terminate acknowledgment packets, finalizing connection closure.

methods.name: fsm_recv_code_rej
methods.description: Handles received code rejection packets.

methods.name: ppp_fsm_proto_reject
methods.description: Handles protocol rejection, transitioning FSM to stopped.

methods.name: ppp_fsm_input
methods.description: Main input handler for incoming PPP packets, dispatching to specific handlers based on packet code.

methods.name: ppp_fsm_recv_protocol_rej
methods.description: Handles received protocol rejection packets.

methods.name: ppp_fsm_recv_echo_req
methods.description: Handles received echo request packets, replying with echo reply.

methods.name: ppp_fsm_recv_echo_reply
methods.description: Handles received echo reply packets, invoking callback if configured.

methods.name: ppp_fsm_recv_discard_req
methods.description: Handles discard requests, typically ignoring them.

methods.name: ppp_send_proto_rej
methods.description: Sends a protocol rejection packet for a given protocol.
